newsitem.title: UK: United titles valued at some 50 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: United titles valued at some 50 mln stg.

text.p: The 47 local newspapers which Britain's United News & Media is planning to sell should raise around 50 million stg, analysts said on Wednesday.
United Provincial Newspapers (UPN), United News' regional newspaper division, has announced plans to dispose of 28 titles in south east England and a further 19 in south Wales.
UPN Chairman and Chief Executive Michael Toulmin told Reuters the titles accounted for some 15 percent of revenue.
UPN reported operating profits of 28.6 million stg in 1995 on turnover of 184.4 million stg. The bulk of UPN's revenue comes from its operations in northern England.
